newsitem.title: PERU: RESEARCH ALERT - Barings downgrades Cementos Lima.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Barings downgrades Cementos Lima.

text.p: ING Barings said Tuesday it had downgraded its recommendation on Peru's leading cement-maker, Cementos Lima, to sell from hold.
-- Barings, in a statement, said this was due to "the recent strong appreciation of the stock (+74.2 percent YTD and 14.2 percent QTD).

-- "Hector Castillo, head of Latin American cement research, and Pablo Moreyra, head of Peru research, think the market has discounted the stock too quickly, forcing them to downgrade Cementos Lima, despite the company's strong growth prospects."

-- "Although ING Barings raised its 12-month target price on Cementos Lima to $22.50 per common share from $20.30, the current market price is still 4.2 percent above yesterday's close of $23.45 per share."
- Barings raised Cementos Lima's 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates from $0.96 and $1.32 per share to $1.06 and $1.44 respectively.
